desc: Design an implementation meeting the \(N=10^5,\ K=10^4\) limits without materializing the \(N^2\) matrix.
Implement input parsing and store \(A\), \(B\), and queries.
Partition \(A\) into blocks and precompute complete-block contributions against \(B\)-prefixes using memory-conscious storage.
Implement fast evaluation of \(\sum_{j\le Y}|A_i-B_j|\) for incomplete \(A\)-block elements.
Answer each query with correct complete-block and partial-block contributions.
Check exact block-boundary cases and 64-bit/integer arithmetic.
Run both provided samples; all public samples passed.
